$comment: scripts/openapi/check_drift.py fails CI on any breaking change to
packages/openapi-client/openapi.json whose signature is not listed here.
Add an entry only when the break is intentional AND existing callers have a
migration. Each entry must name the task that approved it and what a caller
must do; 'signature' is copied verbatim from the check_drift.py failure.
An entry is a permanent record, not a mute button: once the affected
release has shipped and no caller remains on the old contract, delete it.

approved.reason: A release must name a distinct approver whose approval is recorded on the model card; the former default could silently fabricate review authority.
approved.migration: Callers must obtain a recorded model-card approval and send that approver identity in approved_by.

approved.reason: Release actor identity is derived from the authenticated principal instead of trusting an arbitrary request-body default.
approved.migration: Callers should omit requested_by and authenticate normally; during migration, a supplied value must exactly match the authenticated principal.

approved.reason: Monitor actor identity is derived from the authenticated principal instead of trusting an arbitrary request-body default.
approved.migration: Callers should omit evaluated_by and authenticate normally; during migration, a supplied value must exactly match the authenticated principal.
